services.name: Sprinkler Repair
services.summary: Dry spots, leaks, broken heads or a zone that won't shut off. We find the real cause and fix it once. $75 diagnostic, waived when we do the repair.
services.photo_alt: Split irrigation line spraying water in a dug-out hole in a lawn

services.name: Sprinkler Blowouts
services.summary: We clear every zone with compressed air before the first hard freeze, so your pipes and backflow make it through winter.
services.photo_alt: Frost-covered grass blades on a freezing morning

services.name: Spring Start-Ups
services.summary: We turn the water back on slowly, run every zone, adjust heads and fix what winter broke.

services.name: Sod Installation
services.summary: Fresh sod on properly graded soil, with your sprinklers set for new-lawn watering from day one.
services.photo_alt: Worker rolling out fresh sod over prepared soil

reviews.name: Deon W.
reviews.text: Fantastic company. Juan came to my mother's house which was over an hour away from him. He looked at the complete sprinkler system that was already existing but not in use. He determined he could reuse what was existing and just make repairs. Within 2 days the sprinkler system was brought back to life tested and verified. My mother was happy, She has her sprinkler system back. I then had him come to my house because I had a bunch of dead spots in my grass, he changed the orientation of my sprinkler heads and fixed all my issues. He did this as a courtesy even though we paid him but I appreciate his work ethic and his pride in the work he does. Definitely 10 out of 10.

reviews.name: Shae M.
reviews.text: A fantastic crew, really pro work, fair in pricing, customer service is great. Highly recommended
